content: In this extension, we consider a set of weights, which encodes the words frequencies, when performing the PCA. Text classification with TF weighted word subspace can also be performed under the framework of MSM. We show the validity of our modeling through experiments on the Reuters database, an established database for natural language processing tasks. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the word subspace formulation and its extension, comparing our methods' performance to various state-of-art methods.
